---
#title: "Channels"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  template: channels.ejs
  fields: [title, date, image, description]
page-layout: full
body-classes: static-bg
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <script>
      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('tuned-in')) document.documentElement.classList.add('tuned');
        else sessionStorage.setItem('tuned-in', '1');
      } catch (e) {}
    </script>
---
